list.name: student
list.label: Ученик
list.query: SELECT me.telegram_id AS __value, me.doc_name AS __text FROM iam.mentees me ORDER BY me.doc_name

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  date_trunc('$interval', m.scheduled_at) AS time,
  COUNT(*) AS "Созвонов"
FROM meetings.meetings m
WHERE m.scheduled_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  COALESCE(u.name, u.username, m.mentor_telegram_id::text) AS mentor,
  COUNT(*) AS meetings
FROM meetings.meetings m
JOIN iam.users u ON u.telegram_id = m.mentor_telegram_id
WHERE m.scheduled_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND m.mentor_telegram_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY mentor
ORDER BY meetings DESC
LIMIT 15

SELECT
  COALESCE(c.value, 'Без стадии') AS stage,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) AS meetings
FROM meetings.meetings m
JOIN meetings.meeting_users mu ON mu.meeting_id = m.id AND mu.user_id != m.mentor_telegram_id
LEFT JOIN integrations.user_cohorts uc ON uc.user_telegram_id = mu.user_id
LEFT JOIN integrations.cohorts c ON c.id = uc.cohort_id AND c.type = 'Status'
WHERE m.scheduled_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY c.value
ORDER BY meetings DESC

WITH weekly AS (
  SELECT
    m.mentor_telegram_id,
    date_trunc('week', m.scheduled_at) AS week,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM meetings.meetings m
  WHERE m.mentor_telegram_id IS NOT NULL
    AND m.scheduled_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(u.name, u.username) AS "Ментор",
  ROUND(AVG(w.cnt), 1) AS "Среднее в неделю",
  SUM(w.cnt) AS "Всего"
FROM weekly w
JOIN iam.users u ON u.telegram_id = w.mentor_telegram_id
GROUP BY u.name, u.username
ORDER BY "Среднее в неделю" DESC

WITH stage_periods AS (
  SELECT
    user_telegram_id,
    new_value AS stage,
    created_at AS started_at,
    COALESCE(
      LEAD(created_at) OVER (PARTITION BY user_telegram_id ORDER BY created_at),
      now()
    ) AS ended_at
  FROM integrations.stage_transitions
  WHERE cohort_type = 'Status'
),
meetings_per_stage AS (
  SELECT
    sp.user_telegram_id,
    sp.stage,
    COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) AS cnt
  FROM stage_periods sp
  JOIN meetings.meeting_users mu ON mu.user_id = sp.user_telegram_id
  JOIN meetings.meetings m ON m.id = mu.meeting_id
    AND m.scheduled_at >= sp.started_at
    AND m.scheduled_at < sp.ended_at
  GROUP BY sp.user_telegram_id, sp.stage
)
SELECT
  stage,
  ROUND(AVG(cnt), 1) AS "Среднее созвонов"
FROM meetings_per_stage
GROUP BY stage
ORDER BY "Среднее созвонов" DESC

WITH stage_periods AS (
  SELECT
    new_value AS stage,
    created_at AS started_at,
    COALESCE(
      LEAD(created_at) OVER (ORDER BY created_at),
      now()
    ) AS ended_at
  FROM integrations.stage_transitions
  WHERE user_telegram_id = $student
    AND cohort_type = 'Status'
)
SELECT
  sp.stage,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) AS "Созвонов"
FROM stage_periods sp
JOIN meetings.meeting_users mu ON mu.user_id = $student
JOIN meetings.meetings m ON m.id = mu.meeting_id
  AND m.scheduled_at >= sp.started_at
  AND m.scheduled_at < sp.ended_at
GROUP BY sp.stage
ORDER BY MIN(sp.started_at)
